subject: [PATCH v2 3/5] nfsd: don't stamp over an applied delegated mtime at DELEGRETURN

2026-11-06.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the NFSv4 server where the mtime of a file is overwritten when a delegation is returned, even if the client has already applied its own mtime. The fix involves setting dl_setattr whenever the holder's mtime is applied, and updating ctime to the current time if it doesn't pass the ctime validation check. This ensures that the server does not stamp over the client's changes, which can cause issues with file metadata consistency.
